greeting.text: Good day, little sprout! Isn't the meadow air sweet today? Press [Tab] anytime to peek in your backpack, or [M] to view the shrine map.

about_gems.text: Shiny teal and golden gems dot the cliffs and ruins. Pip over by the signpost trades them for handy badges—like a Feather Badge for Double Jumping!

gift.text: Here—take a few pocket gems from my tea jar so you can try out Pip's shop right away. Stay cozy out there!

returning.text: Take your time hopping between the meadow, canopy, and ruins. There's no rush at all—if you slip into a stream, you'll puff right back onto safe ground.

shrines.text: Each region holds a stone lantern Shrine. Attune it once with [E], and you can fast-travel right back from your [M] Map anytime!

all_trinkets.text: My goodness—you found all four lost trinkets across the valley! You have the heart of a true cozy explorer. Take these celebratory Star Gems!

welcome.text: Ribbit! Welcome to Pip's Traveling Satchel! I've got Feather Badges, Breeze Dashes, Clover Boots, and sparkly trails for fair gem prices!

chat.text: Everything I sell snaps right onto your cloak as a Badge. You can toggle abilities or swap cosmetic trails anytime in your [Tab] Backpack!

intro.text: Ahoy, fellow wanderer! I'm sketching the Canopy Cliffs. Don't miss the Canopy Shrine up on the middle bough—it'll link straight to your [M] Map!

secret.text: Rumour says a Mossy Compass sits atop the highest eastern branch. A bouncy mushroom and a Feather Badge will get you right up there!

cartographer_gift.text: Whoa—you've already tracked down two rare trinkets! As one cartographer to another, please take my spare Starlight Trail badge!

post_gift.text: The twilight breeze feels amazing up here, doesn't it? Keep charting every nook!

whisper.text: Hush, warm little sprout... The Sunken Ruins glow brightest when travelers carry our lost Starlight Lantern. Have you spotted it high above?

hint.text: Follow the glowing mushroom pads up to the western stone arch. And don't forget to attune the Ruins Shrine right beside me!

lantern_joy.text: Oh! You found the Starlight Lantern! Its gentle hum warms the whole cavern. Let me bless your satchel with a Magnet Charm!

peaceful.text: May the fireflies always light your ledges, little traveler.
